description: Header file defining interfaces, enums, macros, and constants for NRF clock control driver in Zephyr RTOS, including clock types, start modes, clock sources, and calibration functions.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_calibration_force_start
methods.description: Forces the start of LF clock calibration.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_calibration_count
methods.description: Returns the number of calibrations performed, or -1 if disabled.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_calibration_skips_count
methods.description: Returns the number of skipped calibration attempts, or -1 if disabled.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_control_get_onoff
methods.description: Retrieves the onoff service for a given clock subsystem.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_control_lf_on
methods.description: Permanently enables the low frequency clock.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_bt_ctlr_hf_request
methods.description: Requests high frequency clock for Bluetooth controller activity.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_bt_ctlr_hf_release
methods.description: Releases high frequency clock for Bluetooth controller activity.
